teaser.en: A twining Grewia whose second name, Mbavubavu, points to a healer's remedy for convulsions of the ribs.
teaser.sw: Grewia inayojisokota, ambayo jina lake la pili, Mbavubavu, linaashiria dawa ya mganga kwa degedege la mbavu.
teaser.dg: Grewia unaodzilinga-linga ambao dzinare ra phiri, Mbavubavu, rinaonyesa dawa ya mganga ya nyuni za mbavu.

summary.en: Msokoto is a scrambling Grewia shrub of the coastal bush, named for the way it twines. Pakia also records it under Mbavubavu, the name of a remedy for nyuni wa mbavuni, convulsions affecting the rib cage.
summary.sw: Msokoto ni kichaka cha jenasi Grewia kinachotambaa juu ya vichaka vingine katika vichaka vya pwani, na kimepewa jina kutokana na jinsi kinavyojisokota. Pakia pia anakirekodi kwa jina Mbavubavu, jina la dawa ya nyuni wa mbavuni, degedege linaloathiri mbavu.
summary.dg: Msokoto ni chitsaka cha Grewia cha weruni pwani chinachotandazika dzulu ya mimea yanjina, na dzinare rinalavywa kpwa vira unavyodzilinga-linga. Pakia piya anauandika kpwa dzina Mbavubavu, dzina ra dawa ya nyuni wa mbavuni, nyuni zinazogbwira mbavu.

about.en: Msokoto is a scrambling or twining shrub with alternate, toothed leaves that have three main veins from the base, typical of Grewia. Its small star-shaped flowers are followed by small lobed fruits. Pakia notes that it grows in a twining form, and the name says the same.
about.sw: Msokoto ni kichaka kinachotambaa au kujisokota, chenye majani yanayopishana, yenye meno, na mishipa mitatu mikuu kutoka kwenye kitako, kama ilivyo kawaida kwa Grewia. Maua yake madogo yenye umbo la nyota hufuatwa na matunda madogo yenye pindo. Pakia anaeleza kwamba huota kwa umbo la kujisokota, na jina lake linasema hivyo hivyo.
about.dg: Msokoto ni chitsaka chinachotandazika au kudzilinga-linga, chenye makodza ganayomera mwenga-mwenga kpwa kupishana, gana meno madide kanda-kanda na mishipa mikulu mihahu inayolavywa kula photsi ya kodza, dza irivyo kpwa Grewia. Maruwage madide ga umbo ra nyota gachimala kunamera matunda madide ganayoganyika kpwa seemu. Pakia anaandika kukala unamera kpwa kudzilinga-linga, na dzina piya rinagomba dzambo hiro.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland and thicket, scrambling over other shrubs.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka na vichaka-mwitu vizito vya pwani, ukitambaa juu ya vichaka vingine.
where.dg: Unamera weruni pwani na vitsakani, uchitandazika dzulu ya vitsaka vyanjina.

uses.en: Under the name Mbavubavu, Pakia lists this Grewia among the plants used to treat nyuni wa mbavuni, convulsions affecting the rib cage. This is reported practice, not advice.
uses.sw: Kwa jina Mbavubavu, Pakia anaiorodhesha Grewia hii miongoni mwa mimea inayotumika kutibu nyuni wa mbavuni, degedege linaloathiri mbavu. Huu ni utaratibu ulioripotiwa, si ushauri.
uses.dg: Kpwa dzina Mbavubavu, Pakia anauika Grewia hinyu kahi ya mimea inayohumirwa kuphoza nyuni wa mbavuni, nyuni zinazogbwira mbavu. Hiri ni dzambo ririroandikpwa atu anavyohenda, si ushauri.

culture.en: Mbavubavu comes from mbavu (rib), and Pakia gives it as an example of a plant named after the illness it treats.
culture.sw: Mbavubavu linatokana na mbavu, na Pakia analitoa kama mfano wa mmea uliopewa jina la ugonjwa unaoutibu.
culture.dg: Mbavubavu rinalavywa kula neno mbavu (mbavu), na Pakia anarilavya dza mfwano wa mmea unaoihwa kpwa dzina ra ukongo unaouphoza.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names. Msokoto means 'twine', from sokota (to twist), because the plant grows twining; the word is shared with Swahili. Mbavubavu, 'rib', is shared with Duruma and Giriama. Both names are also used for Grewia holstii, and Mbavubavu is the root of Mbavubavu mkulu (Grewia forbesii) and Mbavubavu mdide (Premna resinosa).
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo. Msokoto lina maana ya 'kusokota', kutoka sokota, kwa sababu mmea huota ukijisokota; neno hili linatumika pia kwa Kiswahili. Mbavubavu, 'mbavu', linatumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kigiriama. Majina yote mawili hutumika pia kwa Grewia holstii, na Mbavubavu ndilo shina la Mbavubavu mkulu (Grewia forbesii) na Mbavubavu mdide (Premna resinosa).
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo. Msokoto rina mana ya 'chitu chinachosokotwa', kula sokota (kusokota), kpwa sababu mmea unamera uchidzilinga-linga; neno hiri ni sawa na ra Chiswahili. Mbavubavu, 'mbavu', ni dzina ra Chiduruma na Chigiryama piya. Madzina gosi mairi piya ganahumirwa kpwa Grewia holstii, na Mbavubavu ndiro dzina ra msingi ra Mbavubavu mkulu (Grewia forbesii) na Mbavubavu mdide (Premna resinosa).

reason.en: The large Mbavubavu, a related rib remedy
reason.sw: Mbavubavu mkubwa, dawa nyingine ya mbavu inayohusiana
reason.dg: Mbavubavu mkulu, dawa yanjina ya mbavu
